ephesians.1.p1.b1.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God,

ephesians.1.p1.b2.text: To the saints in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus:

ephesians.1.p1.b3.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ephesians.1.p2.b1.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.

ephesians.1.p2.b2.text: For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world

ephesians.1.p2.b3.text: He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of His will,

ephesians.1.p3.b1.text: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace

ephesians.1.p3.b2.text: And He has made known to us the mystery of His will

ephesians.1.p3.b3.text: as a plan for the fullness of time, to bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ.

ephesians.1.p4.b1.text: in order that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, would be for the praise of His glory.

ephesians.1.p4.b2.text: And in Him, having heard and believed the word of truth—the gospel of your salvation—you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

ephesians.1.p4.b3.text: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession, to the praise of His glory.

ephesians.1.p5.b1.text: I have not stopped giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers,

ephesians.1.p5.b2.text: I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling,

ephesians.1.p5.b3.text: and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe. These are in accordance with the working of His mighty strength,

ephesians.1.p6.b1.text: … when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms,

ephesians.1.p6.b2.text: far above all rule and authority, power and dominion, and every name that is named,

ephesians.1.p6.b3.text: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.
